name: Melf's Acid Arrow

upcast.text: The extra 1d4 per slot level above 2 applies to both the initial and the delayed damage.

summary: Ranged spell attack: 4d4 Acid on a hit and 2d4 Acid at the end of its next turn; half initial on a miss.
text: Make a ranged spell attack against a target within range. On a hit it takes 4d4 Acid damage, then another 2d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, it takes half the initial damage and none of the later damage. Both the initial and the later damage increase by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 2.
